title: The `mistral` model gets a new backend
summary:
A new backend for `mistral`, sturdier ad handling in streaming text, and a community project added to the list.

The `mistral` text model was switched from a Cloudflare model to `mistral-small-3.1-24b-instruct-2503`, while retaining its 8,192-token maximum and 0.3 temperature.

The `p-ads` marker now forces an ad attempt ahead of the usual eligibility checks, with a Ko-fi fallback when no affiliate matches. The fix also covers streaming responses and more message-content formats.

The community project list now includes Echo AI, an HTML chat interface built with Pollinations text and image generation.
